scanner_c.notes: Sep 18 model-curated financial-news scan emphasizing fresh, identifiable catalysts with U.S.-equity and technology/supply-chain relevance. Major claims were checked primarily against Reuters coverage; distinct events were deduplicated and fewer than 10 retained rather than padding.

items.event_title: China's CXMT eyes NAND flash expansion amid global AI-memory shortage
items.news_summary: CXMT plans to expand beyond DRAM into NAND flash, building an R&D production line in Beijing and positioning against Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and YMTC as AI-server demand tightens memory supply.
items.investor_materiality: Direct competitive and supply-cycle implications for MU, Samsung, SK Hynix and global memory pricing.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-reported strategic expansion in one of the hottest AI supply-chain bottlenecks.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters primary financial-news reporting; exact intraday timestamp not exposed in retrieved result, so date-level timestamp only.
items.youtube_query: CXMT NAND Micron Samsung AI memory shortage
items.video_angle: 中国长鑫突然杀进 NAND：AI 内存缺货会被打破，还是 Micron 又多一个强敌？

items.event_title: Solidigm weighs U.S. NAND memory fab, with New York a leading candidate
items.news_summary: SK Hynix's U.S.-based Solidigm unit is considering a NAND fab in the United States, with upstate New York among leading candidates, amid U.S. reshoring pressure and AI-driven memory demand.
items.investor_materiality: Could reshape NAND capacity geography, capex and competitive dynamics involving MU, Intel-linked assets and Asian memory leaders.
items.selection_reason: Large strategic U.S. semiconductor reshoring story directly tied to AI memory and tariffs/export controls.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters sources-based reporting; project is under consideration, not finalized.
items.youtube_query: SK Hynix Solidigm US NAND fab New York
items.video_angle: SK 海力士要把 NAND 工厂搬到美国？这对 Micron、Intel 和存储价格意味着什么。

items.event_title: Investors digest first Fed rate hike since 2023 as Treasury yields approach 5%
items.news_summary: U.S. investors are reassessing the rate path after the Fed's first increase since 2023, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 5% and oil/inflation risks still central.
items.investor_materiality: Broad valuation and discount-rate implications across U.S. equities, especially long-duration technology stocks.
items.selection_reason: Dominant macro catalyst for the entire U.S. market and directly relevant to next-week positioning.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters market reporting and global-markets outlook.
items.youtube_query: Fed rate hike September 2026 Treasury 10 year 5 percent
items.video_angle: 三年第一次加息之后，10 年美债又逼近 5%：科技股真正要怕的是第二次加息吗？

items.event_title: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
items.news_summary: AI cloud infrastructure company CoreWeave launched a $3 billion convertible debt offering, highlighting the capital intensity of scaling GPU infrastructure; shares fell more than 3% early after the announcement.
items.investor_materiality: Material financing/dilution and balance-sheet signal for a major Nvidia-linked AI infrastructure customer.
items.selection_reason: Concrete multi-billion-dollar financing catalyst with direct AI-capex implications.
items.youtube_query: CoreWeave CRWV $3 billion convertible debt AI cloud
items.video_angle: CoreWeave 又借 30 亿美元：AI 云到底是在高速扩张，还是越来越依赖融资？

items.event_title: Nexperia partners with Tata for chip production and packaging in India
items.news_summary: Nexperia formed a strategic partnership with Tata Electronics to manufacture power chips at Tata's Dholera fab and package/test chips in India after its break with Chinese parent Wingtech.
items.investor_materiality: Important semiconductor supply-chain realignment spanning China, Europe and India, with automotive and consumer-electronics exposure.
items.selection_reason: Identifiable geopolitical semiconductor relocation with concrete manufacturing assets.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on announced strategic partnership.
items.video_angle: Nexperia 离开中国体系后转向印度：全球芯片供应链又往哪边搬？

items.event_title: Bank of Japan raises rates to highest level in 31 years, but yen weakens
items.news_summary: The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31-year high, yet the yen weakened, creating a notable divergence between policy tightening and currency reaction.
items.investor_materiality: Potential implications for global carry trades, Japanese equities, U.S. yields and cross-border liquidity.
items.selection_reason: Major G7 monetary-policy catalyst with unusual market reaction.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters Morning Bid reporting; verify BOJ statement for exact policy-rate level before publication.
items.youtube_query: Bank of Japan rate hike yen September 2026
items.video_angle: 日本加息到 31 年最高，日元反而跌：全球套利交易为什么没被吓跑？

items.event_title: Trump and Xi prepare for Washington meeting with trade, Taiwan and AI on agenda
items.news_summary: Trump is set to host Xi Jinping in Washington next week, with trade, Taiwan, Iran and global AI concerns among the major pressure points.
items.investor_materiality: Potential catalyst for tariffs, semiconductor export controls, China-exposed U.S. megacaps and Taiwan-related risk premia.
items.selection_reason: High-impact upcoming policy event with direct U.S.-China technology and market relevance.
items.youtube_query: Trump Xi Washington trade AI semiconductors September 2026
items.video_angle: 特朗普和习近平下周见面：美股最该盯的不是外交，而是芯片和关税。

items.event_title: Global equity fund outflows hit nine-month high on inflation fears
items.news_summary: Global equity funds saw $23.21 billion of outflows in the week ended Sep. 16, the largest in nine months; U.S. equity funds lost $31.44 billion while technology sector funds still attracted inflows.
items.investor_materiality: Shows broad risk reduction after the Fed hike while technology remains relatively favored, useful for positioning context.
items.selection_reason: Large verified flow shift with a useful divergence between broad U.S. equities and tech-sector demand.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters fund-flow analysis based on LSEG/Lipper-style market-flow data cited in report.
items.youtube_query: US equity fund outflows technology inflows Fed hike September 2026
